summary: Tested ONLY the new 'pre-flight stock check uses the explicitly-chosen Production Model's REAL BOM' wiring. Backend (14 pytest cases, /app/backend/tests/test_model_bom_override.py, 14/14 pass after env reload settled): SAPProductionModelBomClient.get_bill_of_material_id_for_model live against SAP resolves model MAZ42117272-TA_1 (uuid D5F2F9C3-07DD-1EEE-9CE3-4484AC209743) -> BOM 'MAZ42117272-TA_1' (max-VersionID row), unknown uuid -> None; check_component_availability WITHOUT override still returns the cached highest-revision guess (bom_id MAZ42117272-TA_2 -> components ['MAT','HRCOIL1.9X80.5']) while WITH override_bom_id='MAZ42117272-TA_1' + soap client it live-fetches and returns ['MAT','HRCOIL2.0X80.5'] (the real 2.0mm coil) - i.e. the bug fix works; graceful fallback verified for both 'no soap client' and 'soap raises' cases (falls back to cached 1.9mm, never errors). Regression: GET /api/production-confirmation/component-availability (existing-lot tab) byte-identical to the cached-default path, 422 on missing param, no ObjectId leakage; POST /api/production-confirmation/create-and-release-order still validates fine WITHOUT production_model_uuid (400 on blank actor, 400 on bad datetime, 422 on missing fields) and WITH it. Frontend (Playwright + synthetic vms_session): /production-confirmation Create Production Order tab renders source-of-supply-picker, option MAZ42117272-TA_1-P2 selectable, Site auto-fills+locks to P2, UoM locks to EA; submit POST body was intercepted (aborted before reaching SAP so NO real order/proposal was created) and confirmed to carry production_model_uuid=D5F2F9C3-... + logistic_relationship_uuid=FA163ECA-..., job row appears in Active Orders with 'Checking Stock' and the form resets. Out-of-scope regression confirmed unchanged: BOM Explorer still resolves MAZ42117272-TA to MAZ42117272-TA_2 (1.9mm); BOM Explorer / Purchasing Plan / Production Plan(MRP) all load with no JS errors.

critical.issue: The new real-BOM lookup is wrapped in `except SAPProductionModelError` only. SAPProductionModelBomClient uses requests.get(timeout=30) and does NOT wrap transport errors, so a ConnectTimeout/ReadTimeout (backend logs show SAP OData connect timeouts happening regularly on this tenant) propagates to the job's outer `except Exception` and marks the whole order job 'failed' instead of falling back to the cached default. This contradicts the documented design ('a lookup failure just leaves override_bom_id None') and is a NEW failure mode for the model-chosen path. Fix: catch Exception (or wrap requests errors into SAPProductionModelError inside the client).

action_items: Broaden the override-BOM lookup exception handling in _run_create_and_release_job to `except Exception` so an SAP network timeout degrades to the old cached behavior instead of failing the order job.

Data note (not a code bug, but it invalidates one of the stated test premises): SAP currently returns only ONE Source of Supply option for MAZ42117272-TA at P2 (MAZ42117272-TA_1, 2.0mm); MAZ42117272-TA_2 no longer exposes a released source of supply. The picker therefore shows 1 option and is NOT auto-selected, so a user who ignores it sends no production_model_uuid and still gets the old (wrong, 1.9mm) pre-flight check. Consider auto-selecting when exactly one option exists.
critical_code_review_comments: sap_production_model_client.SAPProductionModelBomClient: no retry and no wrapping of requests transport exceptions - inconsistent with the rest of the SAP clients and the direct cause of the HIGH issue above.

check_component_availability's override path correctly skips the live fetch when override_bom_id equals the cached bom_id (cheap no-op) and never writes back to bom_node_cache - matches the 'no retroactive bulk fix' decision.
Live-fetched override BOM shape from _fetch_bom_by_id is compatible with _check_availability_against_stock (items carry 'active' + 'quantity'), verified live - no silent empty-component result.
server.py is 3876 lines - well past the 700-line guideline; the production-confirmation/order-orchestration block (~2085-2600) is a natural module to extract.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable suite: /app/backend/tests/test_model_bom_override.py (run with `-n 0 -p no:randomly`; it self-creates its session). Known env flakiness: writing any file under /app/backend triggers a uvicorn WatchFiles reload whose startup blocks on SAP OData connect timeouts -> the public URL returns 502/60s timeouts for ~1-3 min; wait for GET /api/ to 200 before running HTTP tests (this caused all initial failures, none were product defects). To test the Create Order flow without irreversible SAP writes, page.route-intercept POST /api/production-confirmation/create-and-release-order and fulfill with {"job_id": "..."} - the payload assertion is the only frontend-side thing that needs the real request.
rca_of_the_issue: Original false-shortage bug is genuinely fixed on the chosen-model path: bom_node_cache for MAZ42117272-TA holds bom_id MAZ42117272-TA_2 (1.9mm coil, highest-revision guess), while the material's real released Production Model maps (via productionmodelbomemergent, max VersionID) to MAZ42117272-TA_1 (2.0mm coil). With the override the pre-flight now checks HRCOIL2.0X80.5 instead of HRCOIL1.9X80.5 - live-verified. Residual risk is only the un-wrapped network exception in the new lookup (see backend_issues.critical).
